theorem_title: A least Egyptian-fraction length at lower bound 18 exists and is at most 35
natural_language_statement:
For distinct positive integers $d_i\geq18$, consider representations $\sum_{i=1}^m1/d_i=1$. There exists an attained least length $m$ among all such representations, and

$$
m\leq35.
$$

The bound reproduces an existing 35-term construction. It does not assert that35 is minimum, give a33- or34-term construction, establish the externally reported lower bound, or settle the asymptotic Erdős problem295.
